summary: Whole-game feel, acceptance round 2: 8.3/10, PASS (0 blockers, 0 majors, 5 minors). Both r1 majors are fixed on the real tracks with every unit live. (1) Releasing an L3 drift mid-hairpin (probe-drift.mjs: mountain R27/R26, city R28/R30, coast R46/R60): full lock and a line-holder run 0 m wide with 0 outer-wall hits (was 7.3-8.3 m and 1-5 hits); half lock runs 3.5 m wide with no wall; neutral hands no longer crash (12 deg out, runs 7.3-8.3 m wide, scrapes). With real keys at 1080p (Shift+Right, release at the pink sparks, keep steering) the bike carves the R27 at 25.8 m/s and exits cleanly. (2) Predictable podium: on fresh seeds 9-11 with a passive player, the wins split penguin 3, goose 2, pigeon/cat/shiba/seagull 1 each, the goose makes the podium twice, and the winner leads by 0.1-3.9 s. Over 9 keyboard-bot races 5 rival species win 8 races, and the decent bot wins 7/9 by 0.8-2.2 s; whole fields finish within 3-10 s. Rubber factors of 0.81-1.31 are bike normalisation (pace.ts); a grudge rival does not keep up with a boosted player (probe-payback). r1 minors: KO cinematic now legible (victim in colour with a rim, attacker muted, 2-frame peak flash) at 1.33 s, repeat 0.58 s, WRECKED 0.88 s, all per spec; AI riders crash into traffic in view (6 of 9 keyboard races; race-soak 2 each on city and mountain) and the corgi spawns in every race with fighting (9/9), though natural BUSTEDs stay rare by design (0 in my 27); the hero no longer hides a rival ahead (whole from 7 m, 60 % at 5 m); skill bands are a top strip; a skill pressed mid-skill is buffered (WING casts at 1.2 s, right after GULP); SHOWTIME is faster (impact 1.45 s, 3.0 s in total) but its impact frame is red-tinted (open minor). The first-crash hitch is gone from the rider side, but fx still compiles programs at the first KO (open minor). Numbers vs SPEC 6: feel-telemetry 176/176 (0-60 4.42 s, top 20.0 m/s, brake 12.5, coast 0.6, tau63 0.083 s, input visible in 1 sim frame (1-2 frames, 12-16 ms, with real keys at 1080p), lean 28 deg, no release overshoot, hop 0.375 s, +35 % boost; drift slip 35 deg with 38-40 deg visual yaw, above the spec's 25-30 deg but reads as a deliberate powerslide). On the real tracks crests give 0.73-0.8 s of air and ramps 0.62 s (0.78-0.82 s with a lip hop); PERFECT needs calm hands; a wall gives one impact then scrapes with no HP loss; rider bumps fire once per approach, capped at 5 deg/frame; melee lands 5/11 frames after the press with 0.045/0.1 s hit-stop and 0.25/0.5 shake. race-soak OK on coast/city/mountain, tsc 0 errors, 1080p realtime ~120 fps (P99 10 ms). Open minors: combat knocks still snap the heading 16.8 deg in one frame, the SHOWTIME ring tints the victims, drift sparks are tiny next to the HUD cue, fx programs compile at the first KO, and the test-tool lock race. Evidence: shots/accept/r2-feel/ (drift.log, fair-*-p/d.json, kb-*.json, combat/combat.json, feel-*.log, bump.log, sheet-*.jpg, telemetry/metrics.json).

issues.title: Combat knocks snap the hero's heading up to 16.8 deg in one frame (bumps and walls are eased, knocks are not)
issues.detail: Repro: shots/accept/r2-feel/probe-payback.mjs, coast seed 2: the goose alongside on the left lands a heavy swing at 19 m/s. Player yaw jumps from -2.7 to 14.1 deg in one frame (vx -0.88 -> 4.37 m/s), holds there through the hit-stop, then decays. Seeds 1 and 3 only look smooth (5 deg/frame) because the goose's body contact armed yawEase in the same frame. Cause: attitude.ts sets yaw = atan2(vx, v) and eases it only when sr.yawEase is armed, which happens for walls (surfaces.ts), obstacles (obstacles.ts) and bumps (contacts.ts). Combat's lateral impulse never arms it, so on the hero the whole bike pops sideways instead of being shoved. Plain rider bumps are fine now: one per approach, capped at 5 deg/frame (bump.log).
issues.fix: sim/attitude.ts (or physics step): when vx changes by more than ~1.5 m/s between steps for a reason other than steering or curve push (an external impulse), set sr.yawEase = T.yawEaseTime so knocks swing the nose at <= 300 deg/s like bumps. Add a feel-telemetry 'knock' case: a heavy knock with no body contact must give a max yaw step <= 5.5 deg/frame.

issues.title: SHOWTIME impact: the translucent red ring tints the victims red/pink for ~0.2 s, the one beat that should read cleanest
issues.detail: probe-combat.mjs, coast seed 3, goose/cat/shiba 12/20/28 m ahead (sheet-ult.jpg, combat/ult-f100.png). The fx part is fixed: impact at 1.45 s after P (was 1.83 s), 3.0 s in total (was 3.4-3.7 s), and the victims are bigger than in r1. But at impact +0.22 s the goose reads pink-red and the cat red-orange, because combat's transparent ring/beam crosses them and the KO cast colours show through it. A large white shockwave puff also fills the bottom-centre of that frame. The fx fixer asked combat to hide the ring during cine:ult (status/fx.md, Requests, acceptance round 1), but combat's status has no matching change.
issues.fix: combat SHOWTIME visuals: hide the translucent ring/beam while cine:ult is active, or draw it as an opaque inked ground decal under the victims (depthWrite on, never in front of them). Optional fx follow-up: spawn the shockwave puffs beside and behind the victims, not between the lens and them.

issues.title: Drift-charge sparks are tiny: the level change reads only from the HUD speedometer
issues.detail: probe-sparks.mjs, mountain R27 at 1920x1080, drift held to L1/L2/L3 then released (sheet-sparks.jpg). The 3D sparks at the rear wheel cover about 665 coloured px at L1 (blue) and 681 px at L3 (pink), roughly 0.03 % of the frame, as thin flecks at the bottom edge of the hero. The HUD speedometer cue is clear (DRIFT L1/L2/L3 label colour plus diamonds, red BOOST on release). In commercial kart racers the spark colour change around the wheel is the main timing cue, and players release at the pink sparks.
issues.fix: fx/react/emitters.ts + presets: scale the spark fan per level (L1 small blue, L2 bigger orange, L3 large pink with a ground glow and a short flame jet behind the rear wheel), 2-3x the current sprite size/count, plus a one-shot burst ring on each level-up and on release.

issues.title: The first KO of a session still compiles 4-9 programs mid-race (fx subject mask + zero-light depth variants); frame spikes are intermittent
issues.detail: tools/actors-programs.mjs coast high: afterGo 9, riderOwned 0, so species' fade pre-warm is fixed. All 9 compile at the first KO cinematic: 5 x fx.subjectMask and 4 x '?|depth' zero-light depth variants (the mask pass filters the lights out). probe-kohitch.mjs (realtime 1080p, __br.ko on three rivals 12 s apart) counts 4 new programs at KO 1, 0 at KO 2 and 2 at KO 3. Long frames are intermittent on this shared machine: 135 ms + 67 ms at the first coast KO, and 3 x 58 ms right after the first wreck (probe-rt run 1). Reruns on coast, city and mountain had 0 frames over 33 ms. On a slower GPU a freeze would land exactly on the money shot.
issues.fix: fx: draw the subject-mask pass once during core's warm-up with the real race cast (all riders + traffic groups on layer 30), and enable layer 30 on the scene lights for the mask draw (species' request), so neither the mask nor zero-light shadow variants compile at the first KO. Extend sandbox/fx.warm.mjs to fail when tools/actors-programs.mjs reports afterGo > 0 in a real race.

issues.title: Test tooling: concurrent withPage() calls crash on the browser-slot lock, and scripted controls accept undefined (NaN rider state)
issues.detail: Three fair.mjs runs started together: two died with ENOENT on .locks/browser2/pid and browser3/pid (fair-coast-p.log, fair-mountain-p.log). tools/lib.mjs acquireSlot reads the pid file inside the catch while another process sits between mkdirSync(slot) and writeFileSync(pid). Separately, __br.setControls({ throttle: 1, brake: undefined }) copies undefined over the defaults (input.ts scripted Object.assign), and the next step logs '[sim] non-finite state on rider 0; resetting it' (kb-test.log, mountain seed 1). Real input never sends undefined, but critics' and soak bots can.
issues.fix: tools/lib.mjs: wrap the pid read in its own try. Treat a missing or empty pid as a slot being claimed and skip it; reclaim only when the pid process is gone (or the file is older than ~10 s). src/core/input.ts: drop undefined keys before merging scripted controls (or default each field with ??).
